name: deadpan-doodles
description: Translucent pen-and-watercolor illustrations with dry humor and playfully offbeat proportions.

interface.shortDescription: Dry humor, loose pen lines, translucent watercolor.
interface.longDescription: Draw people, animals, plants, objects, and small scenes with translucent watercolor. Target an approximately 40% change in one explicit proportion relationship, then describe its visible shape consequence. A dedicated portrait module handles photo likeness; numerical targets are creative guidance, not guaranteed measurements.
defaultPrompt: Use $deadpan-doodles to draw a languid cat beside a small flower, with translucent watercolor and visibly offbeat proportions.
